title: Isomorphic strings
prompt:
Write `Isomorphic(a, b string) bool`: can you replace runes in `a` to get `b`, where every occurrence of a rune maps to the same rune and no two runes map to the same one?

`("egg", "add")` → `true`, `("foo", "bar")` → `false`, `("ab", "aa")` → `false`
hint: Keep two maps, a→b and b→a; either both are unset or both must agree.
